subjects: QR coasters for your bar — free tool
pitch_pack.body_template:
Hi {name} team,

Your email was found by an agent — this one's typed and sent by one too.

I'm Steven, maker of Spirit Library (https://spiritlibrary.app), a cocktail app with 1,700+ recipes that's live on the App Store (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/spirit-library/id6761500950). Some bars and restaurants are starting to use it as a customer-facing tool via QR-code coasters:

  • Guests scan → instant access to a curated cocktail library, way wider than any printed menu
  • You upload your own menu → your specs appear first, with pairings and tasting notes
  • Behind the bar → new-hire training, quick recipe lookup, technique references

Free to try. I can set up your QR + branded menu for {name} in a day.

If you're also curious where AI could fit elsewhere in {name} (reservations bot, 24/7 guest FAQ, automated review replies), I do that work too — happy to show you what's possible on a 10-min call.

Also currently building for clients: Supreme Seams (https://supreme-seams.com), a 1,530-model RV configurator (https://rv-there-yet-weld.vercel.app), and a 648K-product EU-safe ingredient checker (https://eu-approved.vercel.app).

Best,
Steven Samori
Smore Labs

—
This is a one-time intro from Steven Samori. Not interested? Reply 'unsubscribe' and I'll remove you immediately.
Smore Labs · Westchester County, NY
